title: strauss.json
description: Configuration for strauss-rs. The options are those of PHP Strauss' `extra.strauss` object in composer.json, without the wrapper.

$schema.description: The location of this schema, for editor completion.

target_directory.description: The directory, relative to the project, the prefixed files are copied to. Leading and trailing slashes are ignored. Must not contain `..`.

namespace_prefix.description: The string to prefix each namespace with, e.g. `Acme\Plugin\Vendor`. Inferred from the first `psr-4` (then `psr-0`) autoload namespace, or the package name, in composer.json.

classmap_prefix.description: The string to prefix class names in the global namespace with, e.g. `Acme_Plugin_`. Inferred from composer.json.

constant_prefix.description: The string to prefix constants declared with `define()` with, e.g. `ACME_`. If empty or absent, constants are not prefixed.

packages.description: The packages to process. If absent or empty, the `require` list in composer.json is used.

update_call_sites.description: Update the project's own files where they use prefixed symbols. `true` uses the files and directories in the project's `autoload`; an array lists them explicitly; `false` (the default) updates nothing.

include_root_autoload.description: Include the project's own `autoload` section when creating the Strauss autoloader.

parallel.description: How many worker processes analyse files. `true` or `0`: one per spare CPU. `false` or `1`: a single process. A number greater than 1: at most that many.

classmap_output.description: Create `autoload-classmap.php` and `autoload.php`. Inferred: `false` when `target_directory` is in the project's `autoload`, otherwise `true`.

override_autoload.description: Autoload settings, keyed by package name, that replace those in the packages' own composer.json.

exclude_from_copy.description: Packages, namespaces and files that are not copied to `target_directory`.

exclude_from_prefix.description: Symbols defined in these packages, namespaces and files are not renamed. Where they are used is still updated.

exclude_files_from_update.description: No changes are made in files matching these packages, namespaces and file patterns.

exclude_constants.description: Like `exclude_from_prefix`, but applies only to constants.

constants.description: Constant names that are never prefixed, e.g. `WP_PLUGIN_DIR` and `ABSPATH`.

exclude_from_string_rename.description: Symbols that are renamed where used in code, but left unchanged where the name appears inside a string.

functions.description: Global function names to leave unchanged inside strings such as `$array['value']`.

namespace_replacement_patterns.description: Patterns to use instead of prefixing with `namespace_prefix`, in priority order: the first to change a namespace wins. A key is literal text unless it starts and ends with the same delimiter character (`~^Acme\\(.*)~`), in which case it is a regular expression. A value can refer to capture groups with `$1`.

delete_vendor_packages.description: Delete the packages' vendor directories after processing.

delete_vendor_files.description: Delete the files copied from the packages' vendor directories after processing.

exclude_git_files.description: Skip files that would not be in the package's distributed archive: the `.git` directory, `.gitignore`d files and `export-ignore` files.

include_modified_date.description: Include a date in the header written to modified files.

include_author.description: Include the author in the header written to modified files.

functionsPrefix.description: The string to prefix global functions with. Defaults to the lower-cased `classmap_prefix`. `false` or an empty string disables function prefixing.

namespaceList.description: Namespaces, matched exactly (not their parents or children). Leading and trailing backslashes are ignored.

patternList.description: Regular expressions matched against file paths relative to the vendor directory. Wrapped in `#` delimiters unless they start and end with the same delimiter character.
